Paul Muigai
Chief Executive Officer
Paul is a seasoned leader with a wealth of experience in Supply Chain management,
having held various roles across the Supply Chain in Unilever Plc, including production
management, procurement, operations planning, engineering and productivity
improvement at various levels up to Supply Chain Director Level. He also held Asia-
Africa and Africa & Middle East Regional expatriate roles in the areas of Supply Chain
optimization and Safety, Health and Eco-efficiency, based in Singapore and Dubai
respectively. Paul is a graduate of University of Nairobi and holds a Bachelor of Science
degree in Mechanical engineering.

Dr. Gerald G. Gitau
Commercial Manager
Dr. Gitau has over 20 years’ experience in Sales & Marketing, Project Management and
System implementations. Previously, he has worked for The Coca-Cola Company
(Nairobi Bottlers) as a Marketer and a Sales Manager and Texaco (Caltex) as a Customer
Care Coach.
He holds a PhD from the University of Nairobi, a master’s degree in project planning and
management and a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in Marketing and in
Information Science. He is a Licentiate Member of the Institute of Management of
Information System (IMIS-UK) with numerous certifications in Business Management
specializing in Sales and Marketing.

Joseph Kamau
Production Manager
Joseph is a Mechanical Engineering graduate from the University of Nairobi. He joined
East African Cables (Tz) Limited in 2009 as Production Manager where he worked for
seven years before being transferred to East African Cables (Kenya) in 2016. He has
also worked in similar manufacturing and engineering roles in other companies namely
Sameer Africa Limited, Lonrho Motors (EA) Ltd and Ministry of Lands and Settlement,
for over ten years.

Esther Lulonde
Human Resources and Administration Manager
Esther joined East African Cables Plc in 2020. With over 15 years of experience in
Human Resources and Administration cutting across Manufacturing, Hospitality and
Real Estate Industries, she has been instrumental in formulation and implementation of
strategy, policies, procedures, and management of organizational performance. Very
keen on employee development, she has designed development programs that have seen
companies get real value of succession planning, talent management and employee
retention. Esther is adept in Human Resources and administration compliance, corporate
governance, Compensation and Benefits, Industrial Relations management, employee
relations management and organization design.
Esther has a Bachelor of Arts in Sociology from Kenyatta University, diploma in Human
Resource Management and is a member of the Institute of Human Resource Management.
